questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) from a distance, the rock looks like a face.

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) been told the news, she was shocked.
questions.explanation: 「（先に）知らされていたので」は完了受動の分詞構文 having been + 過去分詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: All things (   ), the plan was a success.
questions.explanation: all things considered（あらゆることを考慮すると）。独立分詞構文の慣用表現。
